feeds.title: Daily Painters Abstract Gallery
feeds.description: Daily Painters Abstract Gallery was founded by Abstract artist Kimberly Conrad in 2009. DPAG is a community of Abstract Artists from around the world post new original paintings daily. All about Abstract art, Landscape paintings, contemporary painting, expressionism painting, wildlife painting, impressionistic painting, large paintings, abstract painting, colorful paintings & daily paintings

feeds.title: Abstract Paintings by Peter Dranitsin
feeds.description: This blog is by Peter Dranitsin who talks about abstract painting, how colors affect acrylic abstract painting and more.

feeds.title: Megan Chapman's Studio Blog
feeds.description: An abstract painter for over the past twenty years, my work is an intuitive, visual diary of my interior language. The foundation of my work is in the balancing of shape and line with color, texture, and atmosphere.

feeds.title: Ruth Armitage Blog
feeds.description: Ruth Armitage is an artist, teacher, and juror. Her paintings express her connection to her family farm. You can notice similar shapes, colors, and line work in all of her paintings. In her blog, she has abstracted landscapes that are inspired by memories, imagination, and observation of aerial views, visit to see some of her best works.

feeds.title: Ron Deri Hanmade Art Blog
feeds.description: An original abstract art blog by Ron Deri. Browse the blog for posts about art, abstract, painting, home decor and more.

feeds.title: Virtosu Art Blog
feeds.description: Virtosu Art Gallery is one of the worlds contemporary art galleries. We put on display works from our talented artists with the best of contemporary abstract art to bring fresh perspectives to the world of art.
